points.description: States at least 4 valid objectives of IPv6 from this list (equivalent wording accepted): support billions of end-systems / larger address space; reduce routing table size; simplified header / simplified protocol processing; increased security; support real-time traffic / QoS (flow label, traffic class); provide multicasting; support mobility / roaming; open to future change via extension headers; coexistence with existing protocols. Each valid objective is worth 0.25 marks. Repeats of the same idea count once. Unrelated or wrong statements (e.g. 'faster internet speed' alone, 'uses 32-bit addresses') earn nothing.
points.partial_credit: 0.25 marks per distinct valid objective, up to 1 mark for four or more.

rubric.notes: Full marks for four or more distinct valid IPv6 objectives from the model list. Each valid objective gives 0.25 marks; fewer than four gives proportional part marks. Wrong, duplicated or vague items earn nothing.
